title: Quick Roasted Saudi Arabian Steak Kebabs
description: A romantic Saudi Arabian dish featuring roasted fillet of steak, caramelized to perfection, suitable for a satvik friendly diet. This dish is quick, snappy, and full of flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the steak cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the steak cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the kebabs in the preheated oven for 12 minutes, or until the steak is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Remove the kebabs from the oven and let them rest for 2 minutes.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
